_about: Search terms for npm run chrome-search (--queries quick|full|deep, default full). A preset is one list for every platform, or an object per platform (indeed, linkedin, nvb). An empty term "" means the platform's own recommendations for your profile (Indeed relevance; LinkedIn 'Recommended for you', Chrome only). Indeed costs a browser session per 8 pages; LinkedIn keyword searches and NVB go without a browser and only cost the title triage, so their lists can be longer. Measure what each term finds uniquely and prune the ones that add nothing.
